method: Further same-AI source-first challenge of the exact finished pair, actual current compulsory course descriptions/weights and the approved Stage 1 CP060 reasoning. CP060 itself is not reopened or altered.
strongestPositive: CP060 correctly permits broader literary/linguistic programmes despite missing national corpus and historical linguistics. CP309 also receives full positive weight for actual UCR Dutch foundations, cultural research, visual/film/literary interpretation, acquisition/bilingualism, empirical methods and legitimate local/Dutch project choices. Absence of the Dutch corpus alone is not a new rejection rule.
caseSpecificAssessment: The actual CP060 core includes sustained literary analysis/theory, language/communication/media, social interaction, first-language acquisition, psycholinguistics, argumentation/rhetoric, persuasion, public debate and humanities methods, with 60 EC of genuine minor/open space whose contents are not assumed. Those are directly taught general inquiry objects to which its broader UCR alternatives materially respond. CP309 instead integrates extensive applied L2 Dutch learning with country-focused histories, society/film, cultural source work and structural/historical Dutch linguistics. In the confirmed first 120 EC, 45 EC develops applied language use, 25 EC concerns linguistics/acquisition, 40 EC concerns national/cultural subject study and 10 EC is generic philosophy/digital core. These describe this programme's actual weight, not a matching quota.
adjudication: UCR's beginner Dutch is not rejected merely for its level, nor is every missing national literary text decisive. The joint issue is that the broader cultural/empirical-language combinations do not develop the documented sustained applied language practice AND country-specific historical/cultural-linguistic inquiry together. Psycholinguistics and general stylistics are genuine research, but not the taught progression through advanced L2 Dutch grammar, academic registers, historical texts, national historical memory and contextual source interpretation. Broad persuasion/creative/media research cannot be relabelled as those objects: Dutch Debates expressly studies Dutch social questions rather than debating technique. This is a case-specific material-comparability judgment under the same broad-LAS standard; it imposes no degree-equivalence, national-corpus or proficiency veto.
unknowns: A different 10/15 EC concentration or more permissive access/language exception cannot remove that independently documented joint core. The formal conflict remains excluded and is not used as a reason for the negative. A positive comparison of only general interpretive or digital methods would omit known defining study rather than honestly narrow an unknown later-year requirement.
conclusion: The consistency objection is closed with an explicit source-based distinction. Retain the robust no-match for the documented 170 EC; neither a blanket regional-corpus rule nor CP060 approval by analogy determines the result.
